Hustle excuses ko hara deta hai.
"New life ke liye sirf soch kaafi nahi."
Abhi start, future ko tumhari zarurat.
"Future depend karta hai—today tum kya karte."
Motivation shuru karwati hai. Habit chalaye rakhti hai.
Champions galat tak khelte rehte jab sahi ho.
Dots aage dekh ke connect nahi—peeche dekh ke connect.
"Progress ki habit banao."
Winner dreamer hota hai jo kabhi give up nahi karta.
"Tumhari potential endless hai."
Luck tab hoti jab preparation opportunity se milti.
"Dreams tabhi kaam karti jab tum karte."
